description: This file defines the internal class TransactionAgent in the Orleans.Transactions namespace, responsible for managing distributed transactions including starting, resolving, committing, aborting transactions, and handling related logging and utility functions within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: TransactionAgent
classes.description: Implements ITransactionAgent to coordinate transaction lifecycle including starting, resolving, committing, and aborting transactions within Orleans.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Initiates a new transaction, determining overload conditions, generating a GUID, and timestamp.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a transaction by preparing and executing commit or abort phases based on participants and transaction info.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts a transaction, notifying all participants to roll back.

methods.name: CommitReadOnlyTransaction
methods.description: Handles commit logic for read-only transactions, including handling responses and timeouts.

methods.name: CommitReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Handles commit logic for read-write transactions, including prepare, commit, and abort on failure.

methods.name: CollateParticipants
methods.description: Organizes transaction participants into resource, write, and manager categories.
